### 1 — Scene
A fish-and-vegetable meal: cooked salmon, white beans, roasted cauliflower, leafy salad with small toppings, and avocado.

### 2 — Vessel
A rounded-square dinner plate, approximately **26 cm across**. Using the requested circular approximation:
**Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ 530 cm².**

### 3 — Items
Visible foods appear to be salmon with skin, white beans, cauliflower, mixed salad leaves, avocado, small cheese crumbles, walnut pieces, and a little dark-red topping, possibly dried cranberry. A light oil/dressing sheen is also visible.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
Areas below are apportioned to avoid counting overlapping foods twice. Dressing is treated as a coating, not additional plate coverage.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = volume | Density → grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Salmon | 10% | 53 × 1.5 = 80 ml | 0.95 → 76 g | 206 | 157 |
| White beans | 9% | 48 × 1.5 = 72 ml | 0.8 → 58 g | 110 | 64 |
| Cauliflower | 24% | 127 × 2 = 254 ml | 0.6 → 152 g | 35 | 53 |
| Mixed leaves | 24% | 127 × 2.5 = 318 ml | 0.15 → 48 g | 25 | 12 |
| Avocado flesh | 9% | 48 × 2 = 96 ml | 0.65 → 62 g | 160 | 99 |
| Cheese crumbles | 1% | 5.3 × 0.8 = 4.2 ml | 0.95 → 4 g | 265 | 11 |
| Walnut pieces | 1% | 5.3 × 1.5 = 8 ml | 0.6 → 5 g | 654 | 33 |
| Possible dried cranberry | 1% | 5.3 × 0.7 = 3.7 ml | 0.8 → 3 g | 325 | 10 |
| Oil/dressing sheen | Coating | Approximately 5 ml | 0.9 → 5 g | 884 | 44 |

**Coverage check:** 10 + 9 + 24 + 24 + 9 + 1 + 1 + 1 = **79%**, consistent with the visible uncovered rim.

### 8 — Sanity check
The estimated **413 g and 583 kcal** are plausible for this mostly covered dinner plate. Most weight comes from cauliflower, fish, beans, and avocado; the loose leaves and toppings contribute relatively little. Avocado skin is excluded. Dressing and topping identification are the main uncertainties.
